goal: Adjudicate the exact normative bridge from available sufficiently good noncircular reasons to adequate target justification. Compare the independently defended transfer-only requirement, the generative-enhancement reply and the strongest noninferential/holistic alternatives. Show which requirement prevents opposed chains and how actual suitable availability is established. Do not stipulate the foundationalist GeneratedWarrant standard as the whole space of justification.
reason: The owner’s Agrippa/Münchhausen challenge concerns justificatory adequacy, not consistency. The proponents explicitly deny that endless noncircular shape alone suffices. Existing graph, fixed-point and unbounded-finite-depth controls are already certified and do not defend a universal epistemic norm.
